items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: this blues that Baby C wrote... I know he was in New Orleans because in 1912 he had a ragtime piece, song, published by Grunewald there, Baby C

ctx.x: I think it was Tony's tune. But now, I will have to admit that up to the time I last heard Tony, I heard him play very few Bruce, and I heard him sing no Bruce songs. See, he played some of that kind of music, little snatches of it. But he never, he never sang any Bruce songs. He sang mostly popular songs, and he had a couple of instrumental pieces of his own that he played, probably more than that, but two of them he wrote up and tried to get them published in town and they wouldn't publish them. Offered him $5…
